name: 회피의 깃
subject: ONE broad softly CURVED IVORY FEATHER, slightly tilted diagonally. A full plump vane with one gentle curve and a SHORT STOUT tan quill, not a long narrow needle. Warm pale ivory main face, a single cool blue-gray shadow plane dividing the vane along its center, and only TWO or THREE broad stepped barb cuts along the sides. Those cuts are broad and sparse, not many hair strands or little serrations. The feather should feel light and agile but remain substantial at 32x32. Not a wing, leaf or bundle of feathers. No jewel, ribbon, metallic setting, flying streaks, particles or extra colors.

name: 무거운 팔찌
subject: ONE very THICK HEAVY IRON BRACELET in three-quarter view. A broad closed oval metal band, a GENEROUS clearly open wrist opening seen from above, and a deep solid lower/front wall showing its weight and thickness. Muted steel blue-gray main metal face, deep muted blue side/underside shadow, one pale silver upper rim plane. Use thick blunt curved metal, not a skinny wire ring. Plain restrained design, NO spikes, chains, buckles, jewelry stones, fine engraving, scattered rivets, hand or wrist. It must read as an actual wide wearable iron bracelet rather than a pot, doughnut, horseshoe or gemstone ring. Keep the large central opening transparent through the real object.

name: 벚꽃잎 · 검흔 초안
subject: ONE SINGLE large CHERRY-BLOSSOM PETAL (sakura petal), not a whole flower. Its physical shape is an ASYMMETRIC gently curved pale-PINK petal: a wide softly rounded outer tip with a distinctive clearly visible shallow V-shaped split/notch between two uneven rounded shoulders, tapering toward a short rounded base. Slight diagonal bend/curl so it is unmistakably a detached petal, not a symmetric heart, leaf, butterfly, flame or gemstone. Make the identifying notch broad enough to survive 32x32 sampling and the thick outline; preserve it as an exterior silhouette indentation. Main plane soft pink, one muted lilac-pink fold/shadow along one side, at most one small pale curled inner plane. NO leaf veins, stem, stamens, five-petal flower shape, cut marks, many crease lines or loose petals. Convey delicacy with simple curved shape rather than thin lines. Coarse clean pixels and broad flat planes.

name: 네잎클로버 장식 단검
subject: ONE SHORT BROAD SILVER DAGGER with a prominent FOUR-LEAF CLOVER ornament forming its hilt/guard. Arrange diagonally so both the broad straight double-edged blade and the green clover are readable. Blade has a simple pointed tip, pale silver main plane and one blue-gray side plane; no many facets or serrations. The CLOVER GUARD has EXACTLY FOUR clearly rounded GREEN LOBES around a small solid gold center, large enough to count as four at native 32x32. One small stout grip extends only a short distance beyond it, with simple gold/steel hardware; no thin long handle. Clover is physically attached to the dagger, not a separate floating plant. No additional leaves, stem, vines, gems, runes, wrapping stripes, blood, glow, effects or extra objects. Compact friendly fantasy equipment with a big readable blade and cheerful four-leaf charm, not a sword with a tiny illegible symbol.
